## Testing Mode
GREEN

test-exempt: static assets only / non-executable instruction files (behavioral-testing-standard.md Rule 5, exemption criterion 3). ADR files are prose documentation with no executable behavior.

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD3: When this story is complete, a new ADR in docs/adr/ documents the decision to consolidate workflow-mode config into a single key and the rationale for the hybrid shim + migrator approach

## Implementation Notes
- Check docs/adr/ for highest existing number (currently 0013-verifier-severity-authority.md)
- Create docs/adr/0014-workflow-mode-consolidation.md
- Follow exact format of existing ADRs: Status / Deciders / Date / Context and Problem Statement / Decision Drivers / Considered Options / Decision Outcome / Consequences / Links sections
- Status: accepted
- Context: DSO historically used two independent keys — merge.strategy (direct|pr) and enforcement.strategy (local|ci|both) — plus DSO_CI_MODE, DSO_SPRINT_MODE, DSO_MERGE_STRATEGY environment variables. This fragmentation required operators to set multiple keys whose interaction was non-obvious (e.g., merge.strategy=pr + enforcement.strategy=ci is the canonical CI-PR mode).
- Decision: Consolidate into a single dso.workflow key with values: local (default — merge.strategy=direct + enforcement.strategy=local), ci-pr (merge.strategy=pr + enforcement.strategy=ci), ci-local (merge.strategy=direct + enforcement.strategy=ci). Implement via hybrid shim (read-config.sh resolves dso.workflow to legacy values for backward compat) + idempotent migrator (rewrites existing dso-config.conf). Legacy keys remain functional via shim until migration sentinel exists; after sentinel, legacy-key reads are rejected.
- Considered options: (A) hard cutover — replace all legacy key reads immediately (breaks existing configs, high blast radius); (B) shim-only, no migration — keep shim indefinitely (perpetuates confusion); (C) hybrid shim + idempotent migrator — chosen approach (gradual migration, operator control, rejection gate after sentinel)
- Consequences: operators on old configs transparently continue working; new projects use canonical dso.workflow; migration is operator-initiated via migrator script; rejection gate prevents post-migration drift
- Links: epic 3b8b-d7e1-eeff-4796

## DOC_ROUTER_ATTESTATION
Gate fired: 4 (decision rationale — why, not what)
Target file: docs/adr/0014-workflow-mode-consolidation.md
CLAUDE.md edited directly: no — N/A
Lines added to CLAUDE.md: 0

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] docs/adr/0014-workflow-mode-consolidation.md exists
  Verify: test -f $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/docs/adr/0014-workflow-mode-consolidation.md
- [ ] ADR has Status: accepted
  Verify: grep -q 'Status: accepted' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/docs/adr/0014-workflow-mode-consolidation.md
- [ ] ADR documents the dso.workflow key with its three accepted values (local, ci-pr, ci-local)
  Verify: grep -q 'ci-pr' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/docs/adr/0014-workflow-mode-consolidation.md && grep -q 'ci-local' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/docs/adr/0014-workflow-mode-consolidation.md && grep -q 'dso.workflow' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/docs/adr/0014-workflow-mode-consolidation.md
- [ ] ADR documents the hybrid shim + migrator rationale and all three considered options
  Verify: grep -q 'shim' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/docs/adr/0014-workflow-mode-consolidation.md && grep -q 'migrat' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/docs/adr/0014-workflow-mode-consolidation.md
- [ ] ADR links to epic 3b8b-d7e1-eeff-4796
  Verify: grep -q '3b8b-d7e1-eeff-4796' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/docs/adr/0014-workflow-mode-consolidation.md
- [ ] ADR number 0014 is the next sequential (0013 is highest existing)
  Verify: test -f $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/docs/adr/0014-workflow-mode-consolidation.md && ! test -f $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/docs/adr/0015-*.md

## Retry Budget

On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
